findings.title: Sensitive port open to the internet
findings.remediation_hint: Restrict to bastion IPs or SSM Session Manager; use /32 corp egress IPs only.

findings.title: Unrestricted egress (all traffic to 0.0.0.0/0)
findings.description: Security group allows all outbound traffic. Often acceptable, but risky for regulated data planes.
findings.remediation_hint: For sensitive tiers, restrict egress to required endpoints (VPC endpoints, known IPs).
